title: Om Next - David Nolen
summary: David Nolen presents Om Next, the redesign of the ClojureScript Om library, drawing on Relay, Netflix's JSONGraph and Datomic. He covers the tradeoffs in handling the client-server boundary over immutable data.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the lead ClojureScript developer's own account of Om's evolution, one-way data flow and single-state design.

quote.text: David Nolen does a great job talking about the trade offs and the evolution of everything in this talk
